note: All analyses cover January 2022–April 2025 with a November 2023 breakpoint; the displayed reconstructions use the reported 30.4-day divisor. Full oral includes both chemical descriptors. PW denotes an iterative Prais–Winsten implementation; 2–12 and 2–11 specify calendar-month indicators. Mean and level are DDD/day equivalents; slopes are DDD/day equivalents per month. Parentheses are 95% CIs. The terminal percentage compares fitted April 2025 with projected prior-trend continuation. Published people-labelled estimates are DDD-derived, not observed distinct patients; both published overall means are retained. Exact original input, conversion code and Stata settings were unavailable. These are exploratory source-aligned comparisons, not exact replication or a between-study test. The code-restricted PW 2–11 result was −0.74% (−4.69% to 3.21%); all four new models and the frozen GLS models are retained in the audit.
note_zh: 全部分析覆盖2022年1月至2025年4月，断点为2023年11月；表中重建均采用原文30.4日除数。全部口服范围包括两种化学成分描述符。PW为迭代Prais–Winsten实现，2—12和2—11表示月份指示项。均量和水平的单位为DDD/日当量，斜率为每月DDD/日当量变化；括号内为95%CI。期末百分比比较2025年4月拟合值与断点前趋势外推值。原文标为人数的结局由DDD推导，并非实测不同患者人数；保留原文两个总体均值。未获得原始输入、转换代码及Stata设置。这些是探索性口径对齐比较，不是精确复现或跨研究检验。仅该代码范围的PW 2—11月结果为−0.74%（−4.69%至3.21%）；全部四种新模型及冻结GLS模型均在审计中保留。
